During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''doctor''' served aboard a [[Unidentified CR90 corvette (Eyrie Base)|corvette]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He treated [[Ketrian Altronel]] for [[Xebonica]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].
